void Deleteitem(params uint[] itemID) { for (int i = 0; i < itemID.Length; i++) { foreach(WoWItem item in StyxWoW.Me.BagItems) { if(item.Entry == itemID[i]) { item.PickUp(); Lua.DoString("DeleteCursorItem();"); } } } }
void Prosp(WoWItem i) { using (StyxWoW.Memory.AcquireFrame()) { prosp.Cast(); Lua.DoString("UseContainerItem({0}, {1})", i.BagIndex +1, i.BagSlot + 1); } }

void ProspectOre() { foreach(WoWItem i in StyxWoW.Me.BagItems) { if(i.ItemInfo.TradeGoodsClass == Styx.WoWItemTradeGoodsClass.MetalStone && i.ItemInfo.RequiredSkillLevel > 0 && i.ItemInfo.RequiredSkillLevel <= jwc && i.StackCount >= 5 && !ProtectedOre.Contains(i.Entry)) {Log("Prospecting " + i.Name); Prosp(i);} }}
